title: S7/S8 Finding Supplement
description: One append-only supplement to an immutable Finding (L3-S7 §3.6, L3-S8 §2.2). The original finder (or a scheduler-authorized replacement) adds new observation/evidence/correlation refs — typically answering an S8 discriminator-bound follow-up observation or clarification request. A supplement never rewrites the original Finding or its encounter, never re-does the base capture S7 owed, and never carries root cause or repair content; causal judgment belongs to S8. Discriminator gate (L3-S7 §14.1): an S8 follow-up observation must carry hypothesis_id + discriminator + expected_outcomes; an S7 in-round note from the original finder carries none of them and is declared with `runtime finding-supplement --in-round-note`. Everything else is rejected.

supplements_finding_id.description: The immutable Finding this supplement hangs under. The Finding itself and the sealed ObservationBatch finding_ids set never change.

author.description: Agent identity authoring the supplement. Must equal the Finding's original_finder unless a scheduler-appointed replacement is authorized via `runtime finding-supplement --authorized-by` (L3-S8 §2.2).

new_observation.description: The new discriminating fact or clarification text. Bounded in scope: a supplement is not a second base encounter.

evidence_refs.description: Fresh typed evidence refs produced by the controlled observation.

correlation_refs.description: New correlation refs (traces, logs, related findings) tying the observation into the investigation.

discriminator.description: The S8 discriminator this observation answers (L3-S8 §2.1/§8). Discriminator gate (L3-S7 §14.1): required — together with hypothesis_id and expected_outcomes — for every S8 discriminator-bound follow-up observation; a request to re-run an already confirmed symptom without one is rejected. Must stay empty (with hypothesis_id and expected_outcomes) for S7 in-round notes declared via `runtime finding-supplement --in-round-note`.

hypothesis_id.description: The registered S8 Hypothesis the discriminator distinguishes. Required for S8 follow-up observations; S7 in-round notes (--in-round-note) must not carry it.

expected_outcomes.description: The expected distinguishing outcomes of the controlled follow-up observation: which observable result supports vs refutes the hypothesis (L3-S8 §2.2). Required for S8 follow-up — together with hypothesis_id and discriminator — and required for the S8 discriminator-bound follow-up observation. Omitted only on S7 in-round notes (declared with --in-round-note).

hash.description: Independent content hash: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (compact, sorted keys) of this document with the hash field omitted. Lets consumers fingerprint the supplement without trusting the writer.
